testcase.name: band returns to base when heart rate settles
a 20 second stop mid-run does not leave riding
heart rate never changes the mode itself
lift confirmation in progress is cancelled by a riding burst
sustained climb with a still body confirms lift
no signals for long enough decays to paused
riding takes over from lift quickly once lift dwell has passed
falling heart rate while paused eases the band down
violent motion alone can confirm riding when gps and baro are dark
high heart rate narrows the riding band to the top
